metaDesc: Where is the best nightlife in Thailand? Five picks — Koh Phangan (Full Moon), Phuket Patong, Pattaya, Koh Samui Chaweng and Bangkok — with where to stay.
ogTitle: Best Nightlife & Party Spots in Thailand 2026 — 5 Picks
ogDesc: Thailand’s biggest nightlife and party destinations, from Full Moon beaches to rooftop bars, sorted by style, each with where to stay.
intro: Thailand’s biggest nightlife and party destinations, from Full Moon beaches to rooftop bars, sorted by style, each with where to stay.

blocks.html: Short answer: For a beach party choose Koh Phangan (the Full Moon Party); for beach plus nightlife, Phuket (Patong/Bangla) or Pattaya (Walking Street); for beach clubs, Koh Samui (Chaweng); for rooftops and clubs, Bangkok (Sukhumvit/Silom).

items.name: Koh Phangan
items.blurb: Home of the Full Moon Party at Haad Rin, where a global crowd gathers on party nights, plus Half Moon and jungle parties.

items.name: Phuket (Patong)
items.blurb: Bangla Road is Phuket’s nightlife hub — bars, clubs and shows, right by Patong beach and all within walking distance.

items.name: Pattaya
items.blurb: Walking Street packs the nightlife and it is closest to Bangkok, with bars, clubs, beach clubs and shows — a year-round night out.

items.name: Koh Samui (Chaweng)
items.blurb: Chaweng has beach clubs, bars and seaside clubs with a more upscale feel than the Full Moon scene — for partygoers who also want a nice beach.

items.name: Bangkok
items.blurb: Rooftop bars with city views, world-class clubs and the Sukhumvit–Silom–Thong Lo scene — every style in one city.

faq.q: Where and when is the Full Moon Party?
faq.a: It is held at Haad Rin on Koh Phangan on the full-moon night each month (occasionally shifted around Buddhist holy days); rooms fill fast and prices rise on party nights, so book well ahead.

faq.q: Where can I party but still have a nice beach?
faq.a: Koh Samui (Chaweng) and Phuket (Patong) combine nightlife with a good beach in one place, while Koh Phangan outside Full Moon nights has quiet, pretty beaches in the north for relaxing.

faq.q: Where is good nightlife near Bangkok?
faq.a: Pattaya is closest, about a two-hour drive, with Walking Street and beach clubs, while Bangkok itself has rooftop bars and world-class clubs around Sukhumvit–Silom every night.
